tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: List installed Python packages on the target system

tools.name: check_command
tools.description: Check whether a specific CLI command/binary is available on the target

parameters.cmd: The command name to check (e.g. ffmpeg, lsusb, git)

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of an existing file on the target

parameters.path: Absolute path to the file to read

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List the contents of a directory on the target

parameters.path: Absolute path to the directory to list

tools.name: check_port
tools.description: Check whether a specific port is already in use on the target

tools.name: read_existing_project
tools.description: Read all files from a previously deployed project on the target. Use when extending or modifying existing work.
tools.command: find ~/ai-projects/{project} -type f ! -path '*/.venv/*' ! -name '*.pyc' | head -20 | xargs -I{{}} sh -c 'echo "=== {{}} ==="; cat "{{}}"'

tools.name: create_dir
tools.description: Create a directory (and any missing parents) on the target

parameters.path: Absolute or home-relative path to create

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write a file with specified content to the target. Use for config files, .env files, static assets.

parameters.path: Absolute or home-relative path to write
parameters.content: The full content to write to the file

tools.name: install_package
tools.description: Install one or more Python packages via pip on the target (into the system Python, not a venv)

parameters.packages: Space-separated list of packages to install (e.g. 'requests flask')

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run an arbitrary shell command on the target. Use for setup tasks, service checks, or anything not covered by other tools.
